traditional: 喺 A 上面畫一條線
jyutping: hai2 A soeng6 min6 waa2 jat1 tiu4 sin3

english.note: Use this construction when drawing a line across a letter or another written item.

examples.english: You can cross the letter with a line.
examples.traditional: 你可以喺個字上面畫一條線。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 go3 zi6 soeng6 min6 waa2 jat1 tiu4 sin3
